research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen/indexed APH, current/older own biographies, maiden speech, ACECQA2011/12 annual report, Murdoch anniversary, contemporary ABC and targeted school/community/full-time searches. No early employer/hours evidence found. Wales project manager, Melbourne Grammar IT director and Holla-Fresh namesakes excluded.
Priority: identify1984–85 school/payroll and1985–87 community employer/control/hours; pre1984 paid work and study overlap. Queens Park school in speech was mother workplace.

Resolve2000/2001 union promotion via union returns/predecessor history; dates, leave and2013 exit. Board/expert appointment tenure/payment need ACECQA2012/13, ACFA and NDIS records. Governance does not establish another full-time career.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: read ACECQA 2012–13 report, DEEWR appointment table, union 2007 annual return/amendments and 2013 vacancy file. Distinguished intended term from actual resignation and election declaration from earlier employment. Governance payments are sitting fees, not full-time service.

School/community employer and pre-1984 work searches remain unsuccessful. South Australian library result for a welfare-office assistant Sue Lines cannot be linked to this Senator and is not assigned. ACFA/NDIS dates remain for later agency appointment-register search. Union 2000/2001 dispute needs original WA branch election/appointment record; 2007 return cannot resolve it.

Recovered local command error during batch handoff: git status/show invoked in scratch instead of repository returned fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git. Correct repository command and WA2 remote fetch/check recovered; no work lost or terminal blocker.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: Commonwealth material dates the NDIS Workforce and Sector Capacity expert-group announcement to 3 May 2012 and anticipates advice over the following months; this supplies an earliest evidenced appointment point, not an exact legal term. A first-person 2014 speech adds roughly three years of aged-care reform work and significant National Aged Care Alliance representation within the national union role. Searches still did not identify the 1984–85 school, 1985–87 community employer, pre-1984 paid work or an authoritative ACFA appointment term.
